facts.fact: The Smart Zambia Institute is stated to run the Government WAN connecting 87 departments and institutions and shared services (government email, e-Cabinet, electronic payslips) for line ministries and ten provincial headquarters; published date used as the document gives none.
Fifty-two standardised government websites are stated to be developed in-house and hosted on the Zambia National Data Centre, government ICT infrastructure; published date used.

Fifty-two standardised government websites for ministries, constitutional offices and provincial administrations are stated to have been developed in-house and deployed to the Zambia National Data Centre; published date used.
